item.title: OpenSpec: A Lightweight Spec Contract for AI Coding
item.description: 1. What OpenSpec Is OpenSpec is an open-source Spec-Driven Development framework maintained by Fission-AI. It does not try to teach AI new coding tricks. Instead it adds a lightweight “agreement layer” between you and the AI — before any code is written, both sides settle on what to do, in writing.
